text:
morgan: Heads-up — multiple scanner jobs in eu-west-1 started failing ~02:10 UTC. Trivy workers keep restarting or hitting timeouts. Logs show image pull/backoff and some decrypt errors.

ashley: seeing 429s from registry + Snyk webhook 429 spikes. Could be we tripped their rate limits after the big requeue yesterday.

devon: I'm on the cluster now. kube-events show NodePressure then pods evicted, also a lot of `ErrImagePull` followed by `CrashLoopBackOff`. Pulling logs.

scan-bot: [automated] Job 2026-03-20T02:12:03Z trivy-worker-42 failed: timeout after 300s; attempt=3

ravi: separate but related — suppression-db decrypts failing with `AccessDeniedException: not authorized to decrypt` in the same timeframe. If suppressions can't be read we requeue and flood the system.

morgan: right — I noticed the scanner-service IAM role was modified in deploy-2026-03-19 (small perms tighten). Could have broken KMS access.

ashley: that would explain both: no suppressions -> mass resubmits -> registry rate-limit -> image pulls fail -> pods thrash.

devon: rolling back IAM tweak for scanner-service now. @infra can you confirm the role change?

infra: infra: rolled back scanner-service IAM binding; restarted scanner deployment. Also added a temporary registry rate-limit exception for scanner nodes for 1h to help drain backlog.

scan-bot: [automated] 120 pending scans resubmitted in batch 1/6

ravi: please don't resubmit everything at once — that will just re-hit the rate limits. We should requeue in small windows and exponential backoff.

morgan: agreed. can we change resubmit strategy to batch size 20 with jitter? Also add a short-circuit so if suppression decrypt fails we treat as "no suppressions" instead of blocking — but that has caveats for false positives.

ashley: we actually have a fallback, but the code path calls KMS before checking local cache. Need a small code tweak: check cache first, then attempt KMS. If cache miss then async decrypt but allow scan to proceed with marking result as "pending-suppressions-verify".

devon: I'll open a quick PR to reorder the checks and add the batch requeue logic for the resubmitter.

morgan: also create a short-lived metric/alert: `suppressions.decrypt.failures` -> page on >10/min for 5m. We missed alerting here.

ravi: filing postmortem and noting triage delays for CVE reviews. Will include mitigation timeline and impact to scheduled patch windows.

infra: monitoring shows backlog draining after batches and rate-limit lift; kube nodes stabilized.

ashley: :thumbsup: current dashboard shows 73 -> 6 pending in the last 20m.

scan-bot: [automated] All clear: 0 failing trivy workers in eu-west-1 at 02:46 UTC.

morgan: follow-ups: (1) revert risky IAM hardenings without e2e KMS test, (2) add suppression-decrypt alert, (3) change resubmitter to rate-aware batching, (4) short PR to reorder cache/decrypt flow. I'll assign tasks in the ticket.

ravi: noted. I'll coordinate CVE triage owners affected by the scan delay and update sla impact.
